summary: RELX PLC files a Form 6-K announcing a non-discretionary share buyback programme running 23 April–22 May 2026 with a spend of £350 million, part of a £2.25 billion total planned buyback for 2026. Shares purchased will be held in treasury to reduce capital. The programme is conducted under an agreement with J.P. Morgan Securities plc, which makes independent trading decisions within preset parameters. The buyback is authorized by shareholders at the AGM on 23 April 2026, allowing up to 182.8 million shares. No premium or deal terms apply; this is an open-market repurchase. Watch for daily execution updates and the eventual cancellation or retirement of treasury shares.
